summary.text: Jessica González is a Democratic member of the Texas House of Representatives for District 104 and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026.
She took office on January 8, 2019, succeeding Roberto Alonzo, and is an attorney.

paragraphs.text: Jessica Gonzalez was born in Dallas, Texas, according to Ballotpedia.
She earned a bachelor's and a master's degree in criminology and criminal justice from the University of Texas at Arlington and a law degree from Western Michigan University.
Her career experience includes working as a partner at Gandara and Gonzalez, PLLC.
In the 2023-2024 session, Ballotpedia lists her on the Urban Affairs, Appropriations (as vice chair), Business and Industry, and Higher Education committees.
She advanced from the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as the daughter of immigrants from Mexico, born and raised in Dallas, and an attorney.
She said she is passionate about affordability and jobs, public education, civil and voting rights, healthcare, housing and public safety, among other issues.
